amortized_cost.name: Amortized cost
amortized_cost.plain_english: The position's remaining cash flows discounted at the yield it was bought at (its book yield).

aoci_impact.formula: sum over AFS positions of (MV(shocked) - MV(base))
aoci_impact.name: AOCI impact
aoci_impact.plain_english: The available-for-sale part of the change in value, which flows into equity. Pre-tax.

aoci_net.name: AOCI net of hedges
aoci_net.plain_english: AFS change plus the swaps' gain or loss, treating swaps as perfectly effective fair-value hedges.

avg_life.name: Weighted average life
avg_life.plain_english: On average, how many years until the principal comes back.

bond_price.formula: dirty = sum CF exp(-(z(t) + s) t); clean = dirty - accrued
bond_price.name: Bond price
bond_price.plain_english: Each remaining payment discounted at the zero rate plus the sector spread. Dirty includes accrued interest; clean does not.

carry_12m.formula: sum over 12 months of amortized cost x book yield / 12
carry_12m.name: 12-month carry
carry_12m.plain_english: Interest income over the next year at book yields; mortgage balances shrink with the scenario's prepayments. No funding cost or reinvestment.

carry_given_up.name: Carry given up
carry_given_up.plain_english: What the hedge costs in a year: fixed rate paid minus the 3-month floating rate received, on the notional.

discount_factor.formula: DF(t) = exp(-z(t) t), z linear between curve points, flat beyond the ends
discount_factor.name: Discount factor
discount_factor.plain_english: What one dollar paid at a future date is worth today.

dv01.name: DV01
dv01.plain_english: Dollars lost if all Treasury par yields rise 1 basis point. Positive for a long bond position; negative for a pay-fixed swap.

eff_convexity.name: Effective convexity
eff_convexity.plain_english: How much duration itself changes as rates move. Negative means gains are capped in rallies (mortgage pools).

eff_duration.name: Effective duration (curve-based)
eff_duration.plain_english: Roughly the % value lost if all Treasury par yields rise 1 percentage point, from repricing at +/-25 bp.

hedge_sizing.formula: N = -share x DV01_AFS / DV01_swap; key-rate: A n = -b
hedge_sizing.name: Hedge sizing
hedge_sizing.plain_english: DV01 hedges size one 5-year swap to offset 50% or 100% of the AFS DV01; the key-rate hedge solves 2/5/10-year swaps to zero the 2y, 5y and 10y+30y buckets.

htm_unrecognized.formula: sum over HTM positions of (MV(shocked) - MV(base))
htm_unrecognized.name: HTM change, not recognized
htm_unrecognized.plain_english: The held-to-maturity part of the change in value: real, but not shown in the accounts.

key_rate_dv01.name: Key-rate DV01
key_rate_dv01.plain_english: DV01 from moving only the region of the curve around 2, 5, 10 or 30 years. The four add up to the total.

mbs_cash_flows.name: Mortgage pool cash flows (stylized)
mbs_cash_flows.plain_english: Monthly level payment plus prepayments driven by the refinancing incentive. Illustrative parameters, not calibrated.

mbs_price.formula: sum CF_m exp(-(z(t_m) + s) t_m), t_m = m/12
mbs_price.name: Mortgage pool price (stylized, static)
mbs_price.plain_english: Project the pool's cash flows once under the scenario's curve and discount them at the zero rate plus the agency mortgage spread.

mod_duration.formula: Macaulay / (1 + y/2), Macaulay = sum t PV / price
mod_duration.name: Modified duration (yield-based)
mod_duration.plain_english: Roughly the % price change for a 1 percentage point move in the security's own yield.

mortgage_spread.name: Mortgage spread
mortgage_spread.plain_english: Market mortgage rate (Optimal Blue index) minus the 10-year Treasury yield on the same date; held fixed in every scenario.

par_yield.formula: FRED DGS1MO ... DGS30, latest date on which all 11 have values
par_yield.name: Treasury par yield
par_yield.plain_english: The coupon at which a new Treasury of that maturity would sell for exactly 100, from FRED (H.15), on the market data date.

portfolio_aggregate.name: Portfolio aggregation
portfolio_aggregate.plain_english: Values and DV01s add up; durations and convexities are market-value-weighted averages; weight is the share of amortized cost.

rate_shock.name: Rate shock
rate_shock.plain_english: Basis points added to each of the 11 par yields, then the curve is rebuilt. Key-rate shocks use tents at 2, 5, 10 and 30 years that sum to 1.

replay_2022.name: 2022 replay shock
replay_2022.plain_english: Each par yield's actual change from 31 Dec 2021 to 30 Dec 2022 (FRED), applied to today's curve.

scenario_change.name: Scenario change in value
scenario_change.plain_english: Value on the shocked curve minus value today, with spreads held fixed.

swap_par_rate.formula: K = (1 - DF(T)) / (0.5 sum DF(t_i)), swap curve = Treasury zero + spread
swap_par_rate.name: Swap par rate
swap_par_rate.plain_english: The fixed rate that makes a new pay-fixed swap worth zero.

swap_value.name: Swap value (pay fixed)
swap_value.plain_english: Value of receiving floating and paying the fixed rate; gains when rates rise.

zero_rate.formula: T <= 0.5: z = ln(1 + yT)/T; T >= 1: solve (y/2) sum DF(t_i) + DF(T) = 1 with z linear in t between points
zero_rate.name: Zero rate (bootstrap)
zero_rate.plain_english: The single rate for one date that discounts a dollar paid then back to today, solved maturity by maturity so every par bond prices to 100.
